still:still-hob-1389: A bearded man in a light tunic stands on a bench in a smoky, firelit tavern, tipping a tankard over a crowd of rough-looking onlookers.
still:still-hob-1489: A bearded, smiling man in a velvet cap and fur-trimmed robe raises a metal tankard, seated at a table in a warm, candlelit stone tavern with a fireplace behind him.
still:still-hob-1589: In a smoky, candlelit tavern, a young bearded man in a soiled shirt leans on a table gesturing at a dark-coated figure's back while a laughing man behind him raises a pewter mug.
still:still-hob-1689: A bearded, weathered man in a ragged patchwork tunic sits at a wooden table with a pewter tankard, in a dim, smoke-hazed tavern with a stone fireplace, cool grey light.
still:still-hob-1789: A smiling man in a white powdered wig and ornate blue-and-gold coat sits at a wooden desk with a large open book, quill and candlesticks, in a candlelit dark-panelled room, warm mood.
still:still-hob-1889: A bearded man in a dark coat and waistcoat leans over a table toward the viewer in a dim, warm gas-lit pub, brow furrowed, with blurred patrons in period dress behind him.
still:still-hob-1989: A bearded man with grey hair in a brown leather jacket sits at a wooden table in a dim pub, raising a glass of dark beer and smiling, greyish daylight through rain-streaked windows.
still:still-hob-death: A bearded man in a worn leather jacket and a black-haired woman in a black dress sit facing each other over dark beers in a rain-streaked pub window, warm amber light, tender mood, drifting feathers.
still:still-johanna: A gaunt, pale person with wet straggly hair, in a dark overcoat, white shirt and black tie, stands in a rainy lamp-lit street at night, cupping a flame to light a cigarette.
still:still-kindly-ones: A barefoot woman in a blue shirt and orange skirt faces three hooded women in black seated at a wooden loom in a stone cave, holding red thread, in dim warm light.
still:still-legions: A pale blond man in a long black coat, white wings spread behind him, stands facing forward in a smoky red-lit stone hall packed with horned, bat-winged figures carrying weapons, embers smoldering.
still:still-letter: An older grey-haired woman in glasses and a high-collared grey coat stands in a dim library, holding out a wax-sealed letter beside a lit lantern, warm glow, somber mood.
still:still-loki-daniel: A pale man with long blond hair in a brown leather coat holds a sleeping baby wrapped in a blanket on a wet, lamplit city street at night, steam rising nearby.
still:still-loki-fire: A red-haired, braided man in a brown leather jacket kneels in a dark wooden room inside a ring of white flames, cradling a sleeping baby, frost-rimmed windows behind showing a sea in cold blue light.
still:still-lucienne-flee: An elderly grey-haired woman in a dark buttoned coat holds a lit lantern in a burning library, behind her a pumpkin-headed man, a winged girl, children and small gargoyles stand holding lanterns, all lit by red firelight.
still:still-lucienne-stand: Three hooded figures in black robes stand on smoke-wreathed stone stairs holding a thin cord, while a pale woman with a glowing lantern and armed onlookers watch from above amid burning braziers and dark arches.
still:still-lyta: A pregnant woman in a denim shirt sits on a floral couch in a peeling, lamp-lit room while a translucent, smiling man in a yellow-and-red hourglass-emblazoned suit stands behind her, hand on her shoulder.
still:still-lyta-daniel: A crying dark-haired woman kneels in a bare, dim room clutching a toddler in dotted pajamas, cold window light behind them and a ring of small flames on the floorboards.
still:still-lyta-door: A person with long black hair in a grey cardigan and jeans stands facing the camera in a dim, narrow hallway, holding a knife down at their side under a single warm ceiling bulb.
still:still-lyta-oath: A pregnant woman with a black bob and fringe, in a pink dress and open denim shirt, stands in a dim kitchen holding her belly, cold window light on her face, wary and tense.
still:still-lyta-rocking: A dark-haired woman in a grey cardigan sits in a wooden rocking chair in a dim nursery, cradling a swaddled sleeping newborn, lit warmly by a bedside lamp.
still:still-lyta-wakes: A tearful pregnant woman with a black bob sits on a rumpled bed in dim, cold blue light, hands on her belly, beside a nightstand whose clock reads 6:14.
still:still-lyta-walks: A barefoot woman with long black hair, gray cardigan and blue jeans walks toward the camera down a cracked rural road at night, lit by a streetlamp.
still:still-madoc: A grinning, wide-eyed bearded man with glasses, a beige blazer over a black turtleneck, sits in a dim library holding a whisky glass beside a green lamp.
still:still-madoc-desk: A bearded man in glasses, black turtleneck and beige blazer sits at a desk in a dark book-lined study, smiling over a whiskey glass beside a typewriter and stacked books under a green lamp.
still:still-madoc-ideas: A bearded man in glasses and a black turtleneck kneels at a wall covered in handwriting, pen raised, grimacing, as papers swirl around him in dim, warm lamplight.
still:still-matthew: An older grey-haired woman in a grey dress and glasses holds up a glowing lantern in a dim library, loose pages drifting, a black raven spreading its wings on the table before her.
still:still-nada: A tearful young Black woman with braided hair, gold neck ring and pale tattered dress stands sealed behind a grimy glass panel, one palm pressed flat against it, in a dark cave of red-lit rock, coldly lit and bleak.
still:still-nada-free: A tearful Black woman with gold-flecked braids, a wide gold collar and pale linen dress stands behind glass in a hazy white space, one hand raised, gold flakes drifting in soft light.
still:still-norse: Three men at a long wooden table in a warm, torchlit stone hall: a red-haired man in leather, an eyepatched greybeard with a spear and crow, a laughing bearded man holding a goblet.
still:still-nuala-glade: A short-haired, pointy-eared figure in a pale green dress sits on a mossy bank beside a still reflecting pond in a misty birch forest of white flowers and floating lights, in dim cool light.
still:still-orpheus: A long-haired young person stands behind a flower-strewn stone altar in a rocky sea cave, framed by columns and lit candle flames, gazing forward in cool dusk light and a solemn, quiet mood.
still:still-orpheus-wedding: Two women in white robes, one crowned with leaves and holding a lyre, smile at each other in a sunlit olive grove where guests feast at wooden tables, watched by a hooded figure in black.
still:still-painted-sea: A bearded man paints at an easel on a seaside stone terrace while a pink-haired girl dances barefoot; a woman in black sits by wine, a grey dog, warm golden light.
still:still-paul-1988: A gray-haired man in a navy sweater kneels and grips the hand of a bespectacled older man in a plaid-blanketed wheelchair, both in a smoky, dim stone room with a barred window.
still:still-roadtrip: A purple-haired young woman in a striped sweater sits on a rusted red muscle car beside a desert highway, arm raised, smiling, under bright sun with fish floating in the air.
still:still-rose-morning: A pink-haired young woman in a black T-shirt sits on an old wooden bed holding a patchwork quilt, in a sunlit, weathered room with lace-curtained windows, her face tired and watchful.
still:still-rose-road: A young woman with pink hair in a denim jacket sits alone on a wooden bench holding a photo in a dim bus station at dusk, lit by a neon Greyhound sign.
still:still-rose-vortex: A young woman with short pink hair, denim jacket and dark skirt stands in a narrow bookshelf aisle lit by warm lanterns, while books and papers swirl through a glowing pale doorway behind her.
still:still-ruby-blaze: An elderly, bald, bespectacled man in a long coat stands in a dim, grainy, checkered-floor diner, palm out with glowing red light, red lightning arcing past smiling seated patrons and a waitress.
still:still-ruby-call: Seen from behind, a barefoot woman in a long black dress stands on a dark shore facing calm water, a distant red light glowing through cold blue fog.
still:still-ruby-inside: A long-haired figure in a black dress kneels on a reflective red crystal floor, surrounded by towering crimson crystal shards, lit by a diffuse red glow that feels ominous.
still:still-stream: A person in long black sleeves reaches both hands into a shallow rocky stream, red threads trailing from their fingers under dim blue-grey light, cold and quiet in mood.
still:still-tempest: An old, gaunt, grey-bearded man in a dark buttoned tunic sits at a candlelit desk covered in quill-written pages, looking up, while a long-haired woman in black stands at a dark window.
still:still-thessaly: Bare dead trees and a huge full moon over a misty track, where a blonde woman in black stands arms crossed by a stone monolith, a small girl behind her, reflections in a puddle.
still:still-unity: An elderly grey-haired woman in a quilted coat and a pink-haired young woman in a denim jacket hold hands in a lantern-lit book-lined corridor before a swirling vortex, papers and toys floating, dreamlike.
still:still-wake: Three figures — a pale dark-haired woman in black, a bearded man in a heavy coat, an older woman holding a lantern — stand on a stone cemetery avenue lined with candles and rows of mourners in dim, somber dusk.
still:suitors-hall: An empty stone hall, long wooden tables with silver plates, candles and bowls of fruit, six hung banners, tall windows showing a starry night sky, torchlight and candlelight, still and quiet.
still:tavern-1389: A dim, timber-beamed tavern interior: empty plank tables, pewter mugs, candles, straw on flagstone floor, a lit stone hearth throwing smoke and warm light, open door revealing a muddy street, gloomy and quiet.
still:tavern-1989: An empty pub interior: dark wooden benches, a half-full pint on a table, a glowing jukebox and dartboard, rain-streaked windows, dim warm lamplight; no people, quiet and gloomy mood.
still:throne-room: Grey-haired woman in dark coat holds lantern and book; kneeling man in pale suit faces a dark chair on sand in a starry mirrored room, a looming shadow at right, faint candlelight, somber.
still:vortex: Inside a narrow wooden library aisle lined with shelves, books and hanging lanterns, books, loose pages, doors and two toy horses float toward a swirling white-blue vortex, lit warmly and dreamlike.
still:white-room: A single worn wooden chair with a tattered cushion sits alone in a pale, misty void, faint golden particles drifting above it, soft blurred lights behind, quiet and hazy.
still:witch-crossroads: A mossy standing stone in a misty leafless forest at night, where two dirt tracks fork beneath a huge full moon, mirrored in a puddle in the foreground; eerie and cold.
